slices.title: task: cloning the repo and running pnpm install yields a green typecheck and build (Phase 0)
slices.outcome: Fresh clone, `pnpm install && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build` passes; placeholder page renders at `/`.

slices.title: task: pushing a PR triggers CI that typechecks, lints, and builds (Phase 0)
slices.outcome: Open a PR, see green checks for `typecheck`, `lint`, `build`.
slices.adds: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` skeleton with the three jobs and a pnpm cache.
slices.tests: CI run on the PR itself.

slices.title: task: branch protection on main rejects direct pushes and requires CI green (Phase 0)
slices.outcome: `git push origin main` rejected; PR cannot merge until CI passes.
slices.adds: Branch protection rules via `gh api` (relaxed seed; checks list expands across phases).

slices.title: task: a Vercel preview deploys for every PR and renders the placeholder (Phase 0)
slices.outcome: PR opens, Vercel posts a preview URL, `/` renders.
slices.adds: Link Vercel project, configure env vars on Vercel, hook to repo.
slices.tests: Manual visit to the preview URL.

slices.title: task: pull request and issue templates render on github.com (Phase 0)
slices.outcome: Opening a new issue or PR shows the project's templates.

slices.title: task: pnpm test runs Vitest and reports zero suites green (Phase 1)
slices.outcome: Empty test run is green; foundation for TDD.
slices.adds: `vitest.config.ts`, one passing sample test, `pnpm test` script.

slices.title: task: forbidden-chars meta-test fails on a file containing an em-dash (Phase 1)
slices.outcome: Deliberate em-dash in a markdown file fails the `forbidden-chars` CI job; remove, green.
slices.tests: Vitest on the scanner; CI exercise.

slices.title: task: lint and typecheck reject a deliberate any (Phase 1)
slices.outcome: `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` break the build on a deliberate violation.
slices.tests: Deliberate violation in a throwaway PR.

slices.title: task: dependabot weekly PRs land for npm and actions (Phase 1)
slices.outcome: Weekly Dependabot run scheduled.
slices.tests: Manual (wait for the first weekly run).

slices.title: task: codeql runs on PR and weekly on main (Phase 1)
slices.outcome: CodeQL workflow attached; first run completes.
slices.tests: CI run on the seeding PR.

slices.title: task: playwright config exists and an empty e2e suite passes (Phase 1)
slices.outcome: `pnpm test:e2e` runs, no specs yet, green.

slices.title: task: opening / in dark mode shows token-driven colours and self-hosted fonts (Phase 2)
slices.outcome: `/` paints with dark tokens, Fraunces, Geist, JetBrains Mono.
slices.adds: `app/globals.css` imports `tokens.css`; `next/font` self-hosts the three families with Latin subset; layout consumes them.

slices.title: task: clicking the theme toggle cycles system to dark to light without FOUC and persists across reload (Phase 2)
slices.outcome: Visible toggle cycles; cookie persists; SSR reads cookie + `Sec-CH-Prefers-Color-Scheme`.
slices.tests: RTL on toggle; unit on resolver.

slices.title: task: enabling prefers-reduced-motion in DevTools zeros all token durations (Phase 2)
slices.outcome: Durations cascade to 0 via existing tokens.
slices.adds: Documentation in `globals.css`; verification step in PR template.
slices.tests: Visual; RTL on `Reveal` (no observer when reduced-motion).

slices.title: task: scroll reveal animates content in on first viewport entry (Phase 2)
slices.outcome: Sections fade and translate in on first viewport entry; reduced-motion bypasses.
slices.tests: RTL (no observer when reduced-motion); manual scroll smoke.

slices.title: task: subtle film grain overlay renders behind content (Phase 2)
slices.outcome: Grain overlay visible at low opacity; respects theme.

slices.title: task: parsing content/site.json with the canonical schema returns typed Site (Phase 3)
slices.outcome: Loader parses, types flow end-to-end.
slices.tests: Zod parsers per section; round-trip parse for valid + invalid; pinned issue-path snapshots.

slices.title: task: the build fails if content/site.json is malformed (Phase 3)
slices.outcome: Corrupt the file, `pnpm build` exits non-zero with a clear path-aware error.
slices.tests: Unit on the script (exit code, message).

slices.title: task: each project mdx file (stratus, hearth, vessel, quorum, plumb, trace, atrium) parses against the schema (Phase 3)
slices.outcome: Seven mdx files exist with frontmatter; all parse.
slices.tests: Parameterised parser test over all seven.

slices.title: task: the slug normaliser produces kebab-case, strips diacritics, caps at 60, rejects reserved words (Phase 3)
slices.outcome: `slugify('Cafe & Sons!')` returns `cafe-and-sons`; `slugify('admin')` throws.

slices.title: task: any string field containing U+2014 or an emoji is rejected by the schema (Phase 3)
slices.outcome: Defence in depth at the schema layer.
slices.adds: `lib/text/safeText.ts` Zod refinement composed into every long-string field.
slices.tests: Positive + negative for em-dash and a sample emoji.

slices.title: task: the typed loader memoises reads across the same request (Phase 3)
slices.outcome: One fs read per request.
slices.tests: Unit asserting one fs read per request.

slices.title: task: visiting / shows hero, about, skills, experience, AI practice, projects, footer, all from content (Phase 4)
slices.outcome: Server-rendered `/` with all sections, single h1, focus visible.
slices.tests: RTL per section (visibility flags, semantic landmarks, single h1).

slices.title: task: visiting /projects/<slug> shows the case study for any seed project (Phase 4)
slices.outcome: Each of the seven projects renders.
slices.tests: RTL with parameterised slugs; not-found state.

slices.title: task: sitemap.xml lists every project page and robots.txt allows indexing (Phase 4)
slices.outcome: `/sitemap.xml` valid, `/robots.txt` correct.

slices.title: task: the page source contains all section text without JS (Phase 4)
slices.outcome: View-source includes every body string.
slices.adds: Nothing structural; verify Server Components only.
slices.tests: Playwright with JS disabled, assert text presence.

slices.title: task: JSON-LD Person and CreativeWork render in head on / and on a project page (Phase 4)
slices.outcome: Valid JSON-LD blocks present in head.

slices.title: task: a brand-on 404 page renders for unknown routes (Phase 4)
slices.outcome: Unknown routes show on-brand 404.

slices.title: task: clicking the cv link downloads the pdf at /cv/David-Onasanya-CV.pdf (Phase 4)
slices.outcome: Link points at the static file; HEAD returns 200.
slices.adds: Link rendering; the file already exists at `cv/David-Onasanya-CV.pdf`; ensure `/public/cv/` placement.

slices.title: task: first visit shows the cinematic intro, second visit skips it (Phase 5)
slices.outcome: localStorage flag prevents replay; reduced-motion skips entirely.
slices.tests: SSR-safe seenStorage gate; `usePrefersReducedMotion()` SSR default false.

slices.title: task: a custom cursor follows the pointer on desktop only (Phase 5)
slices.outcome: Present on `pointer:fine`, absent on touch and reduced-motion.
slices.tests: Hook unit (refs + raf, no per-frame React state); manual.

slices.title: task: hovering primary buttons triggers a magnetic pull, disabled on touch and reduced-motion (Phase 5)
slices.outcome: Buttons attract the cursor on desktop; static on touch and reduced-motion.

slices.title: task: skill pills marquee scrolls horizontally and freezes on reduced-motion (Phase 5)
slices.outcome: Marquee plays in motion mode, frozen otherwise.

slices.title: task: pressing Cmd or Ctrl+K (or /) opens a command palette with navigation, contact, theme actions (Phase 5)
slices.outcome: Keyboard-only flow; escape returns focus.
slices.tests: Deterministic palette items unit; e2e keyboard flow.

slices.title: task: clicking a project row morphs into the case study via view transitions (Phase 5)
slices.outcome: Project-row to case-study morph plays via view transitions; reduced-motion bypasses.
slices.adds: View-transition wiring on the index and project pages; `react-view-transitions` named transitions.
slices.tests: Manual; RTL for the reduced-motion bypass.

slices.title: task: signing in with the admin email lands me on /admin (happy path) (Phase 6)
slices.outcome: Open `/login`, enter `ADMIN_EMAIL`, receive a magic link via Resend, click it, see `/admin`.
slices.adds: Minimal `lib/auth.ts`, Drizzle adapter, `users`/`sessions`/`verification_tokens` tables, login page, `[...nextauth]` route, middleware.
slices.tests: Unit on token shape; Playwright `e2e/sign-in.spec.ts` happy path against preview, intercepting Resend.

slices.title: task: signing in with a non-admin email shows generic copy and never sends mail (Phase 6)
slices.outcome: Any non-admin email returns the generic message; Resend never called.
slices.adds: `lib/auth/allowlist.ts` with case-insensitive trim, boot-time empty check.
slices.tests: Unit (case, trim, empty boot); Playwright assertion that Resend stub records zero sends.

slices.title: task: sixth sign-in attempt from one IP within fifteen minutes returns 429 (Phase 6)
slices.outcome: Rate-limit shows generic copy; Sentry breadcrumb on 429.
slices.tests: Unit (window arithmetic, fail-closed); Playwright burst test.

slices.title: task: an expired or already-used magic link shows a clear error (Phase 6)
slices.outcome: Stale link redirects to `/login?error=expired` with on-brand copy.
slices.adds: Token expiry + single-use enforcement, constant-time compare, `/login?error=expired` state.
slices.tests: Unit on token verifier; RTL on error state.

slices.title: task: sign-in emails contain no em-dash and no emoji (Phase 6)
slices.outcome: Email payload validated by Zod that rejects U+2014 and `\p{Extended_Pictographic}`.
slices.tests: Unit (positive + negative including a literal em-dash and a sample emoji).

slices.title: task: signing in lands me on /admin where I see editor sections for every site area (Phase 7)
slices.outcome: Nav lists Hero, About, Skills, Experience, AI, Projects, Footer, Settings.

slices.title: task: editing the hero headline auto-saves a draft within 350ms (Phase 7)
slices.outcome: Type, blur, draft persisted in Neon.
slices.tests: Unit on debounce; integration with test DB.

slices.title: task: the live preview pane reflects unsaved draft changes (Phase 7)
slices.outcome: Edit on left, preview pane updates without full rehydration.

slices.title: task: drag-reorder of the project list persists, n renumbered on save (Phase 7)
slices.outcome: Drag persists across refresh; `n` renumbers on save not on drag.

slices.title: task: uploading a 2MB image returns a Blob URL written into the draft (Phase 7)
slices.outcome: Upload yields a Blob URL inserted into the draft; cap at 1.5MB; AVIF transform.
slices.adds: `app/api/cms/upload/route.ts`, signed Vercel Blob upload, `ImageUploader`, AVIF transform via sharp, 1.5MB cap.
slices.tests: Integration with mocked Blob; size cap unit; AVIF unit.

slices.title: task: every editor field shows inline Zod validation errors (Phase 7)
slices.outcome: Field-level Zod errors surface inline next to the field.
slices.adds: Shared `MarkdownField`, `VisibilityToggle`, `Modal`, `Toast` primitives composed into every editor.

slices.title: task: hiding a section via VisibilityToggle removes it from the public preview but keeps content (Phase 7)
slices.outcome: Section disappears from the public render; content stays in the draft.
slices.adds: Visibility flag in schema (Phase 3) consumed in section components.

slices.title: task: pressing publish on a hero edit opens a PR on GitHub with the right diff (Phase 8)
slices.outcome: End-to-end happy path; modal returns a real PR URL.
slices.tests: Unit on tree builder; unit on branch shape; integration with Octokit mocks asserting create-ref / blob / tree / commit / update-ref / create-pr.

slices.title: task: publishing content with a forbidden character refuses to commit (Phase 8)
slices.outcome: Paste an em-dash, press publish, inline error names the field; no branch, no PR.
slices.adds: Defence-in-depth scan in `lib/github/commit.ts` using `lib/text/forbidden.ts` from Phase 1.
slices.tests: Unit; RTL on the publish modal error state.

slices.title: task: publishing the same draft twice updates the existing PR rather than opening a second (Phase 8)
slices.outcome: Second publish force-updates the branch and posts "draft updated"; PR URL unchanged.
slices.adds: Collision detection on branch name, refs PATCH path, 422 mapping.
slices.tests: Unit on 422 reuse; integration mock asserting PATCH on existing ref.

slices.title: task: a stale or wrong GitHub token surfaces a clear configuration error in the admin UI (Phase 8)
slices.outcome: 401 from Octokit yields "GitHub credentials missing or invalid" in the modal, not a stack trace.

slices.title: task: the PR body lists what changed in plain language, no em-dash, no emoji (Phase 8)
slices.outcome: PR body lists per-file diffs with section names and a one-line summary; passes the forbidden-chars meta-test.
slices.tests: Unit (snapshot for a fixture diff; assertion the snapshot is forbidden-char clean).

slices.title: task: requesting /api/og returns a generated OpenGraph image for the home page (Phase 9)
slices.outcome: 200 response, png, brand stripe + Fraunces title.

slices.title: task: requesting /api/og/<slug> returns a per-project OpenGraph image (Phase 9)
slices.outcome: Each of the seven projects has a generated OG card.
slices.tests: Parameterised over the seven projects; rejects U+2014 in inputs.

slices.title: task: legacy paths redirect to canonical urls (Phase 9)
slices.outcome: `/about`, `/work`, etc. 308 to canonical.

slices.title: task: pwa manifest renders with theme-color from brand 500 (Phase 9)
slices.outcome: Manifest finalised with brand theme-color.

slices.title: task: rich-results test passes for Person on / and CreativeWork on a project page (Phase 9)
slices.outcome: Twitter, LinkedIn, Google validators green against preview URL.

slices.title: task: clicking show contact form reveals a form behind Turnstile (Phase 10)
slices.outcome: Form not on first paint; appears on action.

slices.title: task: submitting a valid contact message lands an email and shows a success state (Phase 10)
slices.outcome: Real submission delivers via Resend; success copy shown.
slices.adds: Contact handler via Resend; Zod payload schema rejecting U+2014/emoji.

slices.title: task: rapid resubmits are blocked by Turnstile (Phase 10)
slices.outcome: Turnstile blocks repeat submission.

slices.title: task: page views appear in Vercel Web Analytics (Phase 10)
slices.outcome: Analytics dashboard records page views from the preview.

slices.title: task: a thrown error surfaces in Sentry with source maps (Phase 10)
slices.outcome: Triggered server and client errors land in Sentry with readable stack traces.
slices.adds: Sentry init server + client; source map upload in CI.

slices.title: task: lighthouse CI runs against / on every preview and posts a comment (Phase 11)
slices.outcome: Lighthouse run posts a PR comment with scores.
slices.adds: `.lighthouserc.json` for `/`, `.github/workflows/lighthouse.yml` triggered on Vercel deployment-status success.

slices.title: task: lighthouse CI gates a project page and a deep-dive page on the same budget (Phase 11)
slices.outcome: Budgets cover one project page and one deep-dive page.
slices.adds: Budgets for one project and one project-with-deep-dive.

slices.title: task: a deliberately unoptimised png in a PR fails the lighthouse job (Phase 11)
slices.outcome: Regression catches; revert turns it green.

slices.title: task: lighthouse is required on main alongside ci, e2e, codeql (Phase 11)
slices.outcome: A red lighthouse blocks merge to `main`.

slices.title: task: e2e/sign-in.spec.ts runs against every preview and asserts the magic link round-trip (Phase 12)
slices.outcome: Sign-in spec runs in CI on every preview.
slices.adds: Spec relocated and expanded from Phase 6; CI workflow `e2e.yml` triggered on Vercel preview ready.

slices.title: task: e2e/publish-flow.spec.ts signs in, edits the headline, publishes, asserts a real PR url (Phase 12)
slices.outcome: End-to-end publish smoke green.
slices.adds: Spec; uses the test GitHub token.

slices.title: task: e2e/public-smoke.spec.ts visits / and two project pages, asserts h1, og meta, no console errors (Phase 12)
slices.outcome: Public smoke green on every preview.

slices.title: task: e2e and lighthouse skip on docs-only PRs to save Actions minutes (Phase 12)
slices.outcome: Docs-only PR (markdown change) sees the e2e and lighthouse jobs skipped.

slices.title: task: NVDA and VoiceOver navigate every public page using landmarks and palette announcements (Phase 13)
slices.outcome: Documented audit; fixes shipped.
slices.adds: A11y fixes per audit; PR template manual checklist.

slices.title: task: the real-device matrix (Safari macOS, Safari iOS, Chrome Android, Firefox, Edge) renders without breakage (Phase 13)
slices.outcome: Site renders correctly across the documented browser/device matrix.

slices.title: task: davidonasanya.com resolves to the production deployment over https (Phase 13)
slices.outcome: Domain serves the live site over HTTPS.
slices.adds: DNS records, Vercel domain, `AUTH_URL` env update.

slices.title: task: production lighthouse scores 95+ on Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO (Phase 13)
slices.outcome: Success criterion: 95+ on all four axes.

slices.title: task: a phone-to-live edit round-trip completes in under five minutes (Phase 13)
slices.outcome: Scope success criterion.

slices.title: task: branch protection on main is final (all required checks, enforce_admins true, no force-push, no deletion) (Phase 13)
slices.outcome: Branch protection locked to the launch state.

slices.title: task: CLAUDE.md documents installed Vercel skills and per-task-type preferences (Phase 13)
slices.outcome: Future sessions know which skills are installed and which to prefer per task.
